super-productivity.description:
Super Productivity is a free, open-source task manager and time tracker designed to help you organize work, stay focused, and understand how you spend your time.

Create tasks, subtasks, projects, and tags, then organize your day using a visual planner, schedules, Kanban boards, and the Eisenhower Matrix. Track time spent on activities, use timeboxing to plan focused sessions, and generate timesheets or work summaries for reporting.

Built-in productivity tools include Pomodoro and Flowtime timers, break reminders, focus mode, task notes, recurring tasks, and personal productivity metrics. Integrations with services such as Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Trello, and calendar providers help bring tasks together in one place.

Super Productivity follows a local-first approach and does not require an account for basic use. Optional synchronization and backups are available through supported services, including WebDAV, Dropbox, and SuperSync. Android features include home-screen widgets and convenient task shortcuts.

Available across Android, desktop, and the web, Super Productivity is distributed under the MIT license. Some integrations and synchronization features require internet access or external accounts.
